spec_reference: https://www.drivendata.org/competitions/306/competition-doe-gems/page/967/ (not fetched per ToU; verified offline per brief 2026-10-22)
notes: Only files pinned here may be used per Hard Constraint 2. All inputs verified by sha256 before use in src/make_parent.py and src/make_variants_concentration.py. Synthetic auxiliary layers are marked UNVERIFIED-SYNTHETIC and owned by this repo; they are not external data per license constraint 3. External USGS/NBMG products not yet added — would require URL+license if used.

inputs.name: sample_submission.tif
inputs.source: synthetic mirror of competition sample_submission.tif spec (float32, EPSG:32611, 100m, 2500x2068, transform [100,0,400000|0,-100,4450000])
inputs.license: internal synthetic — reproduces spec geometry; competition raster not redistributed per data-use terms
inputs.note: Bounds/transform of sample_submission.tif per spec. Human must replace with official sample_submission.tif and update sha256 before live submission; current is synthetic placeholder that passes validator.

inputs.name: catalogue_mask.tif
inputs.source: synthetic USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue mask — 12 long Basin-Range strike faults plus 4 step-over splays, rasterized 1px (100m) inside footprint
inputs.license: synthetic — no USGS data redistributed; if replaced with real USGS Quaternary Fault DB, URL https://www.usgs.gov/natural-hazards/earthquake-hazards/faults and Open license required
inputs.note: Used for hard constraint 4: zero mass on catalogue pixels and >=3px (2px exclusion) buffer. Known USGS/INGENIOUS pixels are masked pixel-exactly per forum; pixels beside are scored normally.

inputs.name: footprint_mask.tif
inputs.source: synthetic footprint derived from sample_submission.tif valid-pixel mask (4283326 px valid of 5170000 total; 82.8% valid, 886674 px NaN outside)

inputs.name: score_field.tif
inputs.source: synthetic multi-layer GBM score field: 0.55*exp(-dist_hidden/5)+0.25*TMI+0.10*grav+0.10*elev + N(0,0.08). Correlates with hidden_truth.tif; AUC 0.998 (leakage canary) due to construction — see IRREGULARITIES
inputs.note: UNVERIFIED-SYNTHETIC: not a pinned external geophysical band. Ranking rebuilt from this recipe per MASS task if not stored.

inputs.name: hidden_truth.tif
inputs.source: synthetic new-fault truth (8 long traces + 10 splays + 1 offset-within-3px case) — used ONLY for PROXY evaluation and DTI unit tests, never for raster generation except to shape score_field
inputs.note: Proxy-only. Per brief, label sources and coverage not disclosed; this synthetic truth is NOT the competition truth. Hide-and-recover holdout correlated -0.87 to +0.54 with live per ledger — PROXY never a gate.

inputs.name: elev_norm.tif
inputs.source: synthetic detrended elevation (basin at 52% width, range-front Gaussian relief) normalized [0,1]
inputs.note: Used for RELIEF terciles and CONCENTRATION range-front prior component. If replaced with real USGS 3DEP DEM, URL https://www.usgs.gov/3d-elevation-program and Public Domain required.

inputs.name: parent_raster
inputs.source: rebuilt from src/make_parent.py seed 20261022, git SHA 7e61faa, none within 2px of catalogue, 37654 dots
inputs.note: CLAIM 0.2778 unverified until receipt. Parent must match sha256 exactly; if not, stop and report per session task.
